commander.name: Commander Agent
commander.responsibility: Clarify the user's information request, decision context, priority, scope, and expected output.

collector.name: Information Collection Agent
collector.responsibility: Collect relevant information from trusted sources and preserve source traceability.

analyst.name: Analysis Agent
analyst.responsibility: Separate facts from interpretations and derive implications, hypotheses, and uncertainties.

editor.name: Intelligence Editor Agent
editor.responsibility: Integrate collected and analyzed material into a concise intelligence product for the user.

red_team.name: Red Team Agent
red_team.responsibility: Challenge sources, assumptions, reasoning, confidence, likelihood, and recommendations.

strategist.name: Strategy Agent
strategist.responsibility: Translate intelligence into decision options, recommended actions, risks, and next questions.

knowledge_keeper.name: Knowledge Structuring and Save Agent
knowledge_keeper.responsibility: Convert intelligence outputs into Obsidian-compatible notes with metadata, tags, and links.
